background: The emperor’s own account of the Jin shrine and of the Tang founding, carved in running script — an early example of running script on a stele. Seven attending ministers signed the reverse.

review.note: Draft work record from a government interview with the museum curator. The 1203-character count is his figure.
review.noteZh: 依据政府网站对馆长的访谈整理的草稿；1203 字为受访者所述。

notes: The source discusses the text’s political argument but not the calligraphy’s transmission in any detail.
